title: Claims Valuation Memorandum: Death Benefit Valuation Interest on Deferred Fixed Annuities
content:
Memorandum of the Claims Department on the computation of the death benefit valuation interest on an Ashgrove Deferred Fixed Annuities contract.

## Formal statement

1. **Period.** The death benefit valuation interest runs from the date of the contract's most recent interest credit through the date this contract's death claim was received, counted in actual calendar days. The interest period closes on that date.
2. **Rate and amount.** It is worked at the guaranteed rate of the current guarantee period, as the contract value times one plus that rate raised to the power of the days over 365, less one, rounded to the cent.
3. **Rounding.** The death benefit valuation interest is rounded to the cent once, at the end.

## Inputs

| Input | Where it is read |
|---|---|
| Contract value | The current contract value on the contract record |
| Most recent interest credit | The date of the latest interest credit entry in the activity history |
| Receipt of this contract's death claim | The received date of the death claim recorded on this contract |
| Rate | The guaranteed rate on the contract record for the current guarantee period |

## Worked figure (hypothetical)

Contract value $150000.00; guaranteed rate 5.10%; most recent interest credit 1 February 2026; death claim received 18 April 2026.

| Step | Figure |
|---|---|
| Days from 1 February to 18 April | 76 |
| $150000.00 times (1.051 raised to the power of 76 over 365, less one) | $1561.66 |

The interest period of this credit closes on 18 April 2026.
